title: What It Actually Looks Like for a Godly Man to Be Confident and On His Knees
caption:
Confidence and humility get treated like opposites. They're not. They're the same posture pointed two different ways: sure of who you are, low before the God who made you that way.

One without the other isn't strength. It's an act.

Save this if you've been picking one and calling it the whole thing.
